title: 第六章 黑客出动，和秦漠在游戏中遇到
slug: 国民校草是女生全本免费-国民校草是女生最新章节列表
content_zh:
家里的那台电脑，她已经看过了，打个游戏还行，想要攻克网站，难免会留下漏洞。
所以赚钱是首要任务……
“你说什么？赚钱？“
陈晓东问出这句话之后，司机也被惊到了，一个紧急刹车之后，两个人纷纷回过头来看着傅九，那表情就像是在看什么外星人。
傅九左手还拿着一罐可乐，秀眉皱了皱：“怎么？我说赚钱很奇怪？”
“有那么一点吧。”陈晓东心口不一，太奇怪了好吗！你之前动不动就一天刷一千来展示自己暴发户的气质，那样子让外人看了都想揍你，你现在突然告诉我们说你要开始赚钱了？这不逗人玩吗？
傅九浅笑：“人嘛，都是要改变的，这不最近穷了，总要找点事情做。”
“少爷！”老司机在那抽动了两下，像是非常的感动：“夫人如果听到你这句话，今天晚上肯定能睡个好觉。”
傅九喝了一口可乐：“我妈在外省还有生意要谈，你们就不要麻烦她了，赚钱需要时间，王叔明天帮我去学校请两天假就行。”
王司机，陈晓东：……说了这么久，你不过是为了要请假！
“少爷，你想要在家里休息就直接说，还骗我们说什么你要赚钱。”陈晓东小声嘀咕了一句。
闻言，傅九颇为无奈的长叹了一口气。
她发现不管她说什么，周边的人都不会相信。
毕竟以前她暴发户，不学无术，只会泡帅哥的印象太深入人心！
不过这样也不错。
能更好的进行伪装…
是夜，傅家二楼。
从镜子的方向看过去，只见那老式的键盘上，一双修长白皙的手指迅速的变化的位置。
如果经常玩游戏的人，肯定能看出来，这个人有着极为漂亮的走位！
啪的一声响！

大招发射！
全灭BOSS，首杀完成！
“卧槽！职业玩游戏的来？怎么把幽冥BOSS这关都过了？”
”不是职业的，我花了钱想让个人带我过个小地图，没有想到他居然拿了个首杀，爷也一脸震惊了好吗！”
“那人在哪里？我也要雇他，叫什么名字！装备是不是特别牛？“
“呃，他没有装备，好像是个新人，挺缺钱的样子“
“你骗谁呢，一个新人能过幽冥BOSS？”
“是真的，我刚私信他，他又接了团灭私活，现在在打第二发，一会你们看游戏公告吧。”
这人的话音刚落，全服又迎来一次首杀公告！
然后是第三次，第四次，第五次……第十次！
每一次“黑桃Z“的这个名字都会被高高的挂在游戏大屏幕上！
那宛如加了特效一般的操作手法，看的人们都热血沸腾了！
职业连队里，一个长相软萌的喵系少年，激动的叫了起来：“秦少，你看看这个黑桃Z！太帅了，咱们把他挖过来吧，挖过来吧！“
秦漠双腿搭着，侧过脸去，眸子漆黑，过分白皙的皮肤，让他看上去就像是个吸血贵族，尤其是当他还还披着职业连队的队服时，那慵懒冰冷的气息更是倍加突出：“新手？“

content_en:
She had already seen the computer at home. It was fine for playing games, but if she wanted to conquer the website, it would inevitably leave loopholes.
So making money is the first priority...
"What did you say? Make money?"
After Chen Xiaodong asked this question, the driver was also shocked. After slamming on the brakes, the two of them turned to look at Fu Jiu with expressions as if they were looking at some alien.
Fu Jiu still held a can of Coke in her left hand and frowned: "What? I said making money is weird?"
"A little bit." Chen Xiaodong said something different. It's so strange, isn't it? You used to spend a thousand dollars a day to show your nouveau riche temperament, which made outsiders want to beat you up. Now you suddenly tell us that you are going to start making money? Isn't this funny?
Fu Jiu smiled slightly: "Everyone needs to change. I'm poor these days and I have to find something to do."
"Master!" The old driver twitched twice, as if he was very moved: "If Madam hears these words from you, she will definitely have a good sleep tonight."
Fu Jiu took a sip of Coke: "My mother still has business to discuss in other provinces, so don't bother her. It takes time to make money. Uncle Wang can just go to school for me and take two days off tomorrow."
Driver Wang, Chen Xiaodong: ...After talking for so long, you are just asking for leave!
"Master, if you want to rest at home, just say so, and you lied to us about why you wanted to make money." Chen Xiaodong muttered in a low voice.
Hearing this, Fu Jiu sighed helplessly.
She found that no matter what she said, no one around her would believe it.
After all, the impression that she was a nouveau riche, ignorant and only capable of picking up handsome guys was deeply rooted in the hearts of the people!
But that’s not bad either.
Can better disguise...
It's night, on the second floor of Fu's house.
Looking from the direction of the mirror, I saw a pair of slender white fingers rapidly changing positions on the old-fashioned keyboard.
If you play games often, you will definitely be able to tell that this person has extremely beautiful moves!
There was a snap!
Big move launches!
Destroy all BOSS and complete the first kill!
"Damn it! Are you a professional gamer? How did you pass the Netherworld BOSS?"
"I'm not a professional. I paid someone to take me through a small map. I didn't expect that he actually got the first kill. I was shocked, okay?"
"Where is that man? I want to hire him too. What's his name? Isn't the equipment particularly awesome?"
"Well, he doesn't have any equipment. He seems to be a newcomer and is quite short of money."
"Who are you kidding? Can a newcomer defeat the Netherworld BOSS?"
"It's true. I just sent him a private message. He has taken over the task of killing gangsters again. He is now playing the second round. You can watch the game announcement later."
As soon as this person finished speaking, the whole server received another first kill announcement!
Then the third, fourth, fifth... tenth time!
Every time the name "Z of Spades" will be hung high on the big game screen!
The operation technique was like adding special effects, and everyone who watched it was excited!
In the professional company, a cute-looking cat boy shouted excitedly: "Master Qin, look at this Z of Spades! He's so handsome, let's dig him over, dig him over!"
Qin Mo crossed his legs and turned his face sideways. His dark eyes and overly fair skin made him look like a vampire aristocrat. Especially when he was still wearing the uniform of a professional company, his lazy and cold aura was even more prominent: "Newbie?"
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
